baklava.description: Turkish layered pastry made of thin phyllo sheets filled with chopped nuts and soaked in sweet honey syrup.

churros.description: Spanish fried dough sticks, crispy outside and soft inside, rolled in cinnamon sugar and dipped in hot chocolate.

tiramisu.description: Italian creamy dessert of coffee-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa.

escargots.description: French delicacy of snails baked in their shells with garlic and parsley butter, an unusual and exotic appetizer.

takoyaki.description: Japanese street food: hot round batter balls filled with octopus, topped with savory sauce, mayo and dancing bonito flakes.
takoyaki.mood: street food, weird, exotic, adventurous, octopus, hot

poutine.description: Canadian comfort food of crispy fries topped with squeaky cheese curds and hot brown gravy, heavy and indulgent.
poutine.mood: heavy, cheesy, comfort food, hot, fried

ceviche.description: Peruvian dish of raw fish cured in citrus juice with onion, chili and coriander, served cold, zesty and light.
ceviche.mood: fresh, light, cold, summer, raw fish, citrus

pho.description: Vietnamese hot noodle soup with an aromatic beef broth, rice noodles and herbs, warming and comforting.
pho.mood: warm, hot soup, cozy, winter, comforting

bibimbap.description: Korean mixed rice bowl topped with colorful vegetables, beef, a fried egg and spicy chili paste.

fish_and_chips.description: British pub classic of deep-fried battered fish with thick chips, crispy, salty and filling.
fish_and_chips.mood: fried, crispy, salty, heavy, pub food

tacos.description: Mexican street food of soft corn tortillas filled with seasoned meat, fresh salsa, onion and coriander, spicy and colorful.

samosa.description: Indian fried triangular pastry stuffed with spiced potatoes and peas, crunchy and fragrant.

greek_salad.description: Refreshing Greek salad of raw crunchy vegetables, feta cheese and olives, cold, light and healthy.
greek_salad.mood: fresh, light, cold, summer, healthy, vegetarian

falafel.description: Middle Eastern deep-fried balls of ground chickpeas and herbs, vegetarian, crunchy outside and served in pita with tahini.

donuts.description: American ring-shaped fried sweet dough covered with sugary glaze and colorful sprinkles.
